about_the_game:
The POLYGLOCK demo provides an exciting new way of learning Japanese by combining flash-card style prompts with FPS aiming mechanics. Experience incredible progress and highly durable recall by using both motor and cognitive pathways in your gameplay.

Perfect for total beginners to advanced players. You can learn at your own pace with helpful hints that come complete with professional Japanese voiceovers.

Flex both your knowledge and aiming skills by chasing highscores that show off how many correct answers you entered within the time limit. Each unique combination of learning material selected for the run will have it's own highscore. You can also test and refine your mouse sensitivity easily with a cm/360 calculator in the options.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Phenom X3 865
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 460, ATI Radeon HD 4850, or Intel HD Graphics 4400
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 or AMD Phenom™ II X3 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 660 or AMD Radeon™ HD 7950 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
